name: Janie Fitzgerald
role: Medora young woman who died in 1885
bio: Janie Fitzgerald left Medora with Mrs. Fitzgerald in July 1885 for McGregor, Iowa, for her health. Word of improvement came that month, but on July 30, 1885, the paper reported her death.

moments.label: Left for McGregor, Iowa, for her health

mentions: Mrs. and Janie Fitzgerald left this morning for McGregor, Iowa, where they have gone for the benefit of the latter's health.
Word has been received from Janie Fitzgerald that indicates a speedy recovery from her sickness.

The sad news was received last Sunday that Janie Fitzgerald was dead. It will be a surprise to many of her acquaintances even to know that she was seriously ill. It was but a short time ago that she seemed full of life and health…
